text:
Nora: Hey finance, quick one — corpcard declined at hotel check-in so I had to pay the boarding pass + ferry out-of-pocket. Attached boarding_pass.jpg and ferry_receipt.pdf. Amounts: boarding $42.00, ferry $44.50. Trip date 2026-03-19 SFO->OAK. @Sam FYI for approval.
Priya - Finance: Sorry about the decline. For OOP reimbursements please submit via Concur with receipts. We need itemized receipts or the e-ticket with PNR — boarding pass photos often break OCR. Did you pay with personal card or cash?
Nora: Personal Visa ending 1234. I uploaded `boarding_pass.jpg` and `e-ticket.pdf` to the expense form but the boarding pass image isn't parsing. Booking ref: HJ7K2P.
Priya - Finance: OK — if the e-ticket PDF includes PNR & passenger name that's sufficient. In the form add a short note: "OCR failed, see e-ticket.pdf". We'll accept that. Also need manager approval before payment. @Sam can you approve?
Sam - Manager: Approved for reimbursement. @Priya - Finance can you confirm there's no per‑diem impact? This was taxi/ferry/boarding only.
Priya - Finance: No per-diem change. Process as OOP corpcard exception. Please tag expense with code `TL_TRAVEL` and paste the Concur expense ID in this thread once submitted. We'll mark for expedited reimbursement in the next payroll run.
Nora: Submitted — Concur shows ID `EXP-2026-0319-9872`. I added the note about OCR and attached both files. Anything else needed?
ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0319-9872` submitted by Nora at 2026-03-20 14:12 UTC. Status: awaiting manager approval.
Priya - Finance: I can see the submission and the manager approval. I'll queue this for payment and flag finance ops to expedite. Expect reimbursement in ~5-7 business days. :thumbsup: 
Sam - Manager: Thanks — also can we have card ops whitelist the hotel/vendor to avoid future declines? Nora, was it a soft decline or did it ask for extra auth?
Nora: It returned "transaction declined by issuer" with no CVV/auth prompt. I already opened a ticket with corpcards and CC'd infra-corpcards@redwood; will forward any reply.
Priya - Finance: Perfect — if card ops needs any trace info please include finance@redwood. Closing thread once payment goes through.
